text.card: A red giant 3,123 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.81 solar masses and 13.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,529 K at its surface.
